records.subject: You're in -- let's get Harbor Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Harbor Collective* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, and zero replies to three Wrenfield emails (email:dd6c2a56, email:9369bd1f, email:a35902cd); no tickets, so no signal of active engagement. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance, but silence after onboarding nudges points low.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

I know a new tool is easy to set aside in a busy week, so no worries if Harbor Collective hasn't had a chance to dig in yet. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so setting up one real project is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how your team works.

Would a short call this week help? I'd be glad to walk through getting that first project started with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
